title: Dutch Beef Roast with Juicy Gravy
description: A hearty beef roast recipe with a rich, savory gravy made from the beef's juices. Perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.

ingredients.name: Dutch beef roast
ingredients.notes: Choose a tender cut, such as a prime rib or top round.

ingredients.name: Red wine
ingredients.notes: Optional, for added depth of flavor.

instructions: Season the beef roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth and red wine (if using) to the pot, whisking constantly.
Return the beef roast to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast the beef for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the beef rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
Strain the gravy through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Serve the sliced beef with the rich, savory gravy spooned over the top.
